newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Aug 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Aug 1.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- Front page articles mark celebration activities for 70th anniversary of founding of People's Liberation Army.
- Grand rally held by Central Committee of Communist Party, State Council and Central Military Commission, attended by over 6,000 people, including top leaders and top military officers.

- Jiang Zemin, general secretary of Communist Party Central Committee, delivers speech, says all members of PLA must hold high unswervingly the banner of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics.
- Defence Minister Chi Haotian presides over reception marking 70th anniversary of PLA's founding, says PLA will always strictly follow command of Communist Party and Central Military Commission.
- Central bank governor Dai Xianglong calls for further improving financial services to create good environment for credit
- China state grain purcahses at 7.6 million tonnes by July 25
- China township chemical enterprises increase by 30 percent a year.
- Cement output from January to May was 19.4951 moillion tonnes, up 1.8 percent
